description: The deposit provides an Excel simulation workbook, an Oracle Crystal Ball implementation, Python scripts and supporting inputs for probabilistic planning of distributed fibre-optic sensing along underground oil pipelines. The provider is Eric Gbaden. Coverage: The public description specifies pipeline-segment analysis but does not identify the network, geographic extent, time horizon or spatial resolution. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The public deposit specifies CC-BY-4.0. Reproduction also depends on Excel and Oracle Crystal Ball, whose software terms are separate. Limitations: The instructions require licensed external software and manual workbook setup. No execution, numerical audit or file-integrity test was performed. For simulation it supports sensitivity and value-of-information comparisons for deployment of pipeline monitoring equipment. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
